subject: Go-live slope and commitment bridging
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial runbook: acceptance window and procurement note

Rishi —

Thanks for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency numbers but Procurement flagged two items that will affect our go-live slope: (1) we'd like a 30-day trial period tied to usage caps, and (2) we need audit log export cadence confirmed. Those are gating for a firm date this quarter.

We sketched a tentative MAP internally and attached a working sheet (MAP-v2.xlsx). Current best-case go-live target at Acme is 2027-05-03 but Procurement is pushing for a 2–3 week buffer to complete legal/attestation checks.

Can you confirm whether: 1) audit logs can be exported daily in parquet, 2) we can provision a dedicated burst node for the pilot, and 3) whether Redwood can provide a short credit/discount in the event of a multi-month acceptance delay?

Thanks —
Olivia
Senior PM, Integrations
Acme Health

Attachments: MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial runbook: acceptance window and procurement note

Olivia — thanks for the note and the MAP draft. Short answers up front:
- Audit logs: yes, we can export daily to parquet and push to an S3-compatible endpoint or provide a presigned URL nightly.
- Dedicated burst node: we can scope a restricted dedicated pool for the pilot (estimated +1–2 weeks lead time to allocate hardware depending on region).
- Credit/discount: we can offer a one-time credit tied to delayed acceptance milestones; I'll propose specifics below after checking with finance.

Internal next steps (cc'ing Monica and Markus to own scope and pricing):
- Monica: confirm technical acceptance criteria and confirm export IAM pattern for Acme's S3.
- Markus: provide a quick pricing sketch for a 30-day trial + delayed acceptance credit term.

Olivia — would you be open to a brief alignment call tomorrow to finalize the MAP timeline? I can bring a draft SOW excerpt so Procurement sees concrete language.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial runbook: acceptance window and procurement note

Rishi / Monica —

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Procurement flagged one additional requirement that will drive a go-live slope adjustment: they need a documented rollback plan and acceptance criteria for token retention/PII minimization during the pilot. Without that we cannot close on an official window.

We're sympathetic to Redwood's hardware lead times but at this point the team would prefer to move the firm internal target to 2027-05-17 to give Procurement time to run a short audit. If Redwood can commit to: (A) daily parquet exports, (B) a dedicated pilot node with a documented rollback, and (C) a 60% credit if we delay acceptance beyond 45 days post-pilot start, Procurement will expedite approval.

I'll attach the Procurement checklist; goal is to have an agreed MAP and SOW by Mar 30.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Infrastructure Operations
Acme Health

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (PDF, 52 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial runbook: acceptance window and procurement note — escalation and proposed bridge

Team —

Appreciate the clarity. We're aligned on the technical asks and can meet (A) and (B) as described. On (C) the 60% credit is higher than our standard practice; finance has approved a conditional bridge: a tiered credit tied to milestone slips — 20% credit if acceptance slips 30–45 days, 45% credit if acceptance slips 46–75 days. We can cap the total credit and handle the exact wording in the SOW.

To keep the MAP timeline firm and avoid indefinite drift, proposed immediate actions:
1) Redwood will draft a short rollback and data-retention appendix (Monica to lead) and circulate by EOD Wed 24 Mar.
2) Markus to provide a dedicated-pilot pricing and hardware allocation note by Thu 25 Mar.
3) Laura to prepare an exec escalation note offering a one-time onboarding credit (per Markus' pricing) that we can present to Acme if Procurement requires exec-level assurance.
4) Olivia/Daniel: confirm whether Mar 30 SOW deadline is still feasible with these artifacts — if not, confirm a revised firm SOW date.

If Procurement confirms the revised internal target of 2027-05-17, we'll prioritize allocation to meet that go-live slope and will lock the tiered-credit language into the SOW. If Procurement needs further escalation, Laura will join an exec sync early next week.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
